findings.title: Qualify later Save As source-guard rebinding explicitly
findings.contract: approved17 retains acquired source while updating displayed publication name
findings.impact: Universal rebind changes existing source-stale and cross-directory source authority without a declared consumer migration or original later-SaveAs qualification.
findings.required_change: Preserve approved source-anchor behavior or explicitly qualify and migrate later loaded/already-bound SaveAs name/guard semantics before F/G authoring; test old-source/new-output mutation and cross-directory cases.
